sources.title: Qwen3-32B — specs, VRAM, license, benchmarks | LocalLLMs
sources.snippet: Qwen3-32B is a 32-billion parameter language model developed by Alibaba's Qwen team, released in 2025 as part of the Qwen3 family. The model excels at multilingual conversation, coding tasks, and reasoning, building on the strengths of earlier Qwen iterations while introducing improved instruction following and agentic capabilities.
